notes.title: Virtual Sniper is Now on PC Platform
notes.notes:
Hello, Snipers!
The big day has come! Virtual Sniper is now on Steam. Get ready to find yourself in the middle of breathtaking sniper action.

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3396420/extras/4.png?t=1734958282[/img]

Take your position, set your target and dive into the heat of battle in this adrenaline-filled game where strategy and precision shooting meet.
With its dynamic gameplay, impressive visuals and challenging missions, Virtual Sniper offers an experience that will keep you engaged in every moment. Are you ready to take the shot?
